children: European energy stocks trade higher Tuesday morning as oil continues to gain on fears of prolonged supply disruptions in the Middle East. Brent, the global oil benchmark, rises 1.8% to $98.74 a barrel, while WTI futures are up 3.1% to $94.32 a barrel. This pushes Britain's BP up 1.4% and Shell 0.9% higher. Norway's Equinor gains 1.3% and Italy's Eni rises 1.1%. Spain's Repsol climbs 1%.(adam.whittaker@wsj.com)
